title: Round 5 of Finals. CSKA upset UNICS to capture the trophy
description: UNICS - CSKA 55-66 CSKA conquered VTB League title. They upset UNICS in Kazan to lift the trophy. The guests trailed by 4 points at the halftime before their 32-17 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Nigerian center Tonye Jekiri (212-1994, college: Miami, FL) orchestrated the victory by scoring 11 points and 9 rebounds. Belarusian forward Anton Astapkovich (202-1994) contributed with 12 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. Melo Trimble finished with 10 points and was named the Finals MVP. American center Jalen Reynolds (208-1992, college: Xavier) answered with 18 points and 8 rebounds and the other American import guard Marcos Knight (191-1989, college: MTSU, agency: Slash Sports) added 8 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists in the effort for UNICS.
imageCaption: CSKA upset UNICS to capture the trophy (Photo: vtb-league.com)
